n1.speaker: nino
n1.text:
You're back! You're REALLY back!
Coach! COACH! Ash is back!

n3.speaker: tero
n3.text:
Three years, Ash. The Netyard went quiet.
The Gulls hold our pin now. Salt's crew.

n5a.speaker: tero
n5a.text:
Hm. Still all 'I'.
The cage will teach you.

n6.speaker: juno
n6.text:
okay okay okay — story time later
GAME time now, yes? yes

n8.speaker: nino
n8.text:
THE NETYARD OPENS ITS GATES!
(I'm doing the announcements. Nobody asked. I don't care.)

p1.speaker: salt
p1.text: Well, well. The ghost of Brine Harbor.

p2.speaker: salt
p2.text:
Beat us and the pin's yours.
Lose — and you go back to being a rumour.

p3.speaker: tero
p3.text:
First to three bells.
The wall is your sixth man. Trust it.

r2.speaker: tero
r2.text:
Again. The Gulls swarm the ball —
so the space is always BEHIND them. Pass. Move. Ring it.

a1.speaker: salt
a1.text:
...Take it. The pin.
You earned it — for real.

a2.speaker: salt
a2.text:
But Spicegate's next on the ladder,
and Nadia doesn't play nice like me.

a3.speaker: nino
a3.text:
FIRST PIN! I'm writing it down!
The Ledger remembers EVERYTHING.

a5.speaker: system
a5.text:
PIN EARNED — THE BRINE GULLS
Chapter 1 (vertical slice) complete. Spicegate arrives in the next build.
